notes: Kindergarten MMR coverage by county for 2024-25, supplied by TDH (single cohort). Joined onto the combined-school county row of the compliance report for the same year. The former page_url (health/cedep/immunization-program.html) answers 404 since at least 2026-09-08.

Annual Kindergarten Immunization Compliance Assessment Report, one PDF per school year, 2019-20 to 2024-25, all linked from the TDH immunization page (checked 2026-09-09). File names vary by year (2020_KindergartenSurveyReport.pdf is 2019-20; K-Survey-Report-2020-2021.pdf to K-Survey-2023-2024.pdf; 2024-2025-Tennessee-...-Report.pdf); the ingest renames them by school-year start. The 2024-25 URL pattern applied to earlier years returns 404. Appendix 1 Table 1 (county table) and the public and private statewide summaries are read; Appendix 2 county pages are images. The posted files are 8-29 MB each; raw/ holds only the pages the parser reads (8 to 11 a year, under 1 MB each), written with qpdf::pdf_subset() from a temporary download, so fetch_state describes the subset, not the posted file. The 2017-18 and 2018-19 school listings on the same page are the kindergarten_school_reports_pdf entry. tn.gov intermittently resets connections and returns 404 for existing pages.

Kindergarten Immunization Compliance Assessment school listings for 2017-18 (2018_Public_Report_FINAL.PDF and 2018_Private_Report_FINAL.PDF, named by the school-year end) and 2018-19 (2018_19_Public_Report.pdf and 2018_19_Private_Report.pdf), linked from the TDH immunization page as '2018 Public Report' and so on (checked 2026-09-09). One row per school with enrollment and the count and share fully immunized, religious exemption, medical exemption, temporary certificate, excluded transfer within 30 days (public listing only), incomplete record and missing record, with a COUNTY TOTAL row per county (95 public and 25 private each year) and a STATEWIDE TOTAL row. The ingest reads only the total rows, into data.csv.gz county and state rows for 2017-09-01 and 2018-09-01; the school rows are not written. Superseded by the compliance reports from 2019-20, so no new file is expected (publish_month null). Files are 0.2-0.6 MB; raw/ holds the table pages and drops the cover page. The 2018-19 private listing carries Sevier County as two blocks (Sevier, Sevier County), which are summed.

TDH coverage-rate dashboard export: one row per responding public or private school with kindergarten enrollment and the count fully immunized, missing record, religious exemption, temporary certificate, medical exemption and incomplete record. School years 2019, 2020 and 2021 (start year) as of 2026-09-08; the file is overwritten in place. Documented in CRD Data Dictionary.xlsx on the same page. The dashboard also posts VAX_COVERAGE_SCHOOL_RATES_4_6.CSV (TennIIS registry coverage by county, vaccine, month and demographic group for ages 4-6), not ingested.
